italian-reading-2.title: Hard C
italian-reading-2.subtitle: Read ca, co, and cu
italian-reading-2.description: Hear the hard C sound in ca, co, cu and find it in familiar words.

ir2-p1.translations: Nina sees a house. Mina sees a thing: a rose.

ir2-t1.text: In ca, co, cu, C has a hard sound: casa, cosa, cucina.

ir2-t2.text: Do not apply this rule to every word with C: we will study ce and ci separately.

ir2_q1.question: In which syllables does C have the hard sound taught in this lesson?

ir2_q2.question: In which word does C come before A?

ir2_q3.question: Which word has hard C before O?

ir2_q4.question: Which word contains C before U?
